newsitem.title: USA: US House Budget chair says no budget deal yet.
newsitem.headline: US House Budget chair says no budget deal yet.

text.p: House Budget Chairman John Kasich said Tuesday no budget deal had been reached yet and he was reluctant to talk about negotiations.
"We're not there yet," the Ohio Republican said. "I just don't know if we're going to get there."

He said the current talks were "a whole different environment" than what occurred in the previous Congress. "This is an environment in which we've been able to carry on long conversations without most of them finding their way into the press," Kasich said. The participants have been able to build a level of trust between them, he added.
"This is going to be very tough if we get an agreement; it's going to be very tough if we don't get an agreement," Kasich said.
